name: serverest-api-tests
description: Testes automatizados da API ServeRest com Postman e Newman

scripts.test:ci: newman run ServeRestAPITests.postman_collection.json -e env.postman_environment.json -r cli,htmlextra,junit --reporter-htmlextra-export ./reports/newman-report.html --reporter-htmlextra-title 'ServeRest API Tests Report' --reporter-htmlextra-browserTitle 'ServeRest API Report' --reporter-htmlextra-showEnvironmentData --reporter-htmlextra-showGlobalData --reporter-junit-export ./reports/junit-report.xml
scripts.test:users: newman run ServeRestAPITests.postman_collection.json -e env.postman_environment.json --folder 'User Admin' -r cli,htmlextra --reporter-htmlextra-export ./reports/users-report.html
